description: The W55 tax fixture: one issued invoice at tax_rate 10 with tax_enabled true, two items — 2 x 10.00 taxable and 1 x 5.00 non-taxable — so recalc_invoice_totals puts subtotal 25.00 / tax_amount 2.00 / total 27.00 on the invoice. Over it the legacy CSV repeats the INVOICE-level 2 and 27 on BOTH rows (the S8 bug, W55), while the endpoint writes per-line 2/22 and 0/5 (W44). All other bytes — header, Date, Customer, Email, id cells, quantities, rates, line totals, the unquoted Y/N and the quoted "USD" — must be byte-identical.
usage: Seed block first (patients, appointments, invoices, invoice_items), then POST /api/quickbooks-export with request. Its window (5 Aug 2025, created_at) contains no other fixture's issued invoice, so a combined scratch database still answers exactly this one. The invoice-email endpoint is driven with requests[0] and legacy_inputs.invoice_emails[0] as the byte reference (the with-tax totals block, W56).

contract.invoices_csv: expected old-vs-new diff (W55): buildInvoicesCsv(legacy_inputs.export_invoices, request) ends its two rows ,Y,2,27 and ,N,2,27 — the shipped row interpolates invoice.tax_amount and invoice.total on EVERY item line, so the 10% invoice tax of 2.00 and the 27.00 invoice total repeat even on the non-taxable line. The endpoint ends ,Y,2,22 and ,N,0,5 instead (S8/W44: line 20.00 taxable at 10 percent carries 2/22; the non-taxable 5.00 line carries 0/5, so the two lines sum to the invoice's 27.00). Every other byte — header, Date 8/5/2025, customer cells, INV-00000003 id cells, 2, 10, 20, unquoted Y, 1, 5, 5, unquoted N, and both quoted "USD" cells — is byte-identical.
contract.invoice_email: byte-identical to buildInvoiceHtml(legacy_inputs.invoice_emails[0]) and to invoiceEmailSubject(...) (W56, with-tax case): the totals block carries the INVOICE-LEVEL Tax 2.00 and Total 27.00 rows exactly as the shipped template renders them from the invoice columns — the ported email-invoice builder reads the same invoice-level figures, so the S8 per-line change is CSV-only and the HTML matches byte for byte.
contract.seeding: line_total, subtotal, tax_amount, total and paid_amount/status follow from the schema triggers (recalc_invoice_totals taxes only the taxable subtotal when the invoice's own tax_enabled is true: 20 x 10% = 2.00); the seed block omits those columns and the values above are what they compute.
